high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sohinidutta__," taken 11 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The post shows a hand holding a Zepto delivery bag. The bag features a festive design with illustrations of people celebrating, including scenes of New Year's countdown, gift exchanges, and joyful gatherings. The text on the bag reads "Zepto" prominently in the center. The top right corner of the image includes a notification that says "ARRIVED IN 8 mins," indicating that the delivery has been received within eight minutes of the expected time.
